versions.changelog:
Initial release providing a workflow to discover and recruit startup employees via Twitter using Apify scrapers.

- Enables searching and filtering of professionals currently employed at startups, with enrichment of their Twitter profiles.
- Returns relevant candidate info: handle, name, current company (from bio), role level, follower count, and open-to-work/career change signals.
- Designed for recruiters, HR teams, and talent leads targeting technical/startup candidates.
- Includes a candidate scoring system and edge case/bot detection for cleaner results.
- Output formatted for quick review and outreach prioritization.
